protocol.donors: one deepest library (>10× across cached sites) per documented donor
protocol.panel: 12 donors; same 8 opposite-lineage donors plus 4 depth-matched replacement slots
protocol.lineage_absent: all 12 references outside the target's broad myeloid/lymphoid lineage
protocol.type_absent: 4 alternative cell-type donors from the same broad lineage and 8 outside it
protocol.type_dose: 1, 2, or 4 nested substitutions of the matching cell type in the 4 related slots
protocol.random: sampled from sites with ≥10 reads in ≥7 reference libraries in every panel arm
protocol.marker: same eligibility, chosen with ≥25 percentage-point reference mean difference between four matching and four related donors
protocol.truth: two disjoint 37.5% count partitions, at least 6 reads in each; tests thin the remaining counts with identical draws across panel arms
protocol.context: all scored sites held out from the global profile, each target masked in local fits; other measured neighbors can be used
protocol.aggregation: average draws within each donor, then donors; 2,000 paired donor bootstrap resamples for the MAE difference versus the type-absent arm
protocol.scope: model includes the known reference-residual approximation; low-rank-only, mean, and Research BLUP are controls. Broad macrophage, CD4 and B labels can mix subtypes and sources.

protocol.source: Chromosome 21 deep WGBS counts from the local IHEC/BLUEPRINT and Loyfer collections
protocol.donorSelection: One deepest eligible library per verified donor; fixed-seed balanced subsample by type; one held-out distinct donor per type in each fold. B pools B and memory B; CD4 pools CD4-labeled T subsets. Macrophages pool venous activation states and are cultured. Neutrophils are mature venous only.
protocol.query: Per-site mixture truth is the exact weighted average of held-out deep empirical CpG fractions (each donor has >=10 counts at used loci). Simulated coverage is Poisson at nominal depth and methylated reads are binomial at mixture truth. The omitted-type weight is fixed; remaining weights use the same symmetric Dirichlet(3,3,3) draw across omission doses and depths. Reads are identical across estimator arms at overlapping loci.
protocol.roles: Independent training-based marker ranking in disjoint 10 kb block partitions for fit, diagnostic and score. Full fit uses full atlas; omitted fit and diagnostic select among retained types only. Target coverage determines available empirical truth, without using target methylation to rank markers. Scoring uses a common fixed sample of 6,000 loci per fold, with paired evaluation only where the synthetic query has no reads.
protocol.contrastScoring: A separate retrospective test set includes 3,000 loci with the largest gap between the candidate reference mean and the range of the retained reference means. It is selected in the scoring blocks from reference data, excludes all other fit, diagnostic and score loci, and is never used for mixture fitting or mismatch detection.

models.equal: Equal type weights in complete atlas
models.fitted: Complete atlas, simplex weights fitted by binomial count likelihood
models.oracle: Complete atlas, true simulated fractions applied to reference templates
models.omitted: Selected type removed, simplex weights fitted across the remaining types; omitted type weight fixed to zero

protocol.diagnostic: Mean Pearson squared residual across validation markers with reads, using only the omitted fit and retained templates. AUC compares each positive dose with matched zero-fraction controls under the same omitted atlas and depth. Each fold's nominal 95th-percentile threshold uses only negatives from other folds, so the observed FPR may differ from 5%. Threshold shown is the mean across folds. A misfit score flags inconsistency; it cannot identify an unknown type or distinguish omission from technical mismatch.
protocol.limitations: Synthetic CpG counts, independent Poisson coverage and empirical held-out truth are not fragment-level validation, clinical mixtures, or real cell counts. Reported proportions are DNA fractions. Four template classes retain source, activation and subtype effects. Balanced template size is four per represented type; removing a type also reduces total reference libraries. Repeated draws share their source donors, and thresholds are exploratory rather than externally validated.
